Notes on ergonomics from comparing chairs for the home office.

- Adjustable lumbar support matters more than a headrest for long sitting sessions.
- Seat depth should leave two or three fingers between the seat edge and the back of the knee.
- Armrests should sit at desk height so the shoulders stay relaxed.
- Mesh backs run cooler than foam but sag sooner.

Shortlist: the refurbished mesh chair, the one with the sliding seat, and the cheap one from the "office" outlet.
Sit in each for at least twenty minutes before deciding.
